Title: Propygenta NF - Tube of 30gm Cream - Clobetasol Propionate, Neomycin Sulphate, topical corticosteroid, contact dermatitis : Amazon.in: Health & Personal Care
Propygenta NF Cream is a topical medication for various inflammatory skin conditions. It is particularly indicated for managing conditions where a combination of potent corticosteroid and antibacterial therapy is necessary. The cream contains Clobetasol Propionate, a strong corticosteroid; Neomycin Sulphate, a broad-spectrum antibiotic; and Sorbic Acid, a preservative with mild antifungal properties. This cream is prescribed to relieve inflammation, redness, itching, and discomfort caused by several skin disorders. Propygenta NF is indicated in the management of various skin conditions, such as: Eczema, Psoriasis, Contact dermatitis (irritant or allergic), Seborrheic dermatitis, Infected skin allergies, Lichen planus, Pruritus (itchy skin), Inflammatory skin lesions with secondary bacterial infections, Certain types of acne or folliculitis, as deemed appropriate by a doctor. Propygenta NF helps control disease progression and promote healing of the affected area by offering anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and preservative effects in one formulation. It is unsuitable for long-term use or application on large surface areas unless prescribed. Conditions such as perioral dermatitis, rosacea, or untreated skin infections (like fungal or viral infections) are generally contraindicated for corticosteroid application and require a different treatment approach. Always consult a dermatologist before starting or continuing the use of Propygenta NF to ensure correct diagnosis, suitability of the treatment, and monitoring for side effects, especially in long-term or repeated applications. Propygenta NF Cream offers multiple benefits owing to its combination of a potent steroid (Clobetasol), an antibiotic (Neomycin), and a preservative (Sorbic Acid). It must be noted that this cream is not recommended for general moisturizing purposes or as a cosmetic solution for skin darkening, acne scars, or fungal infections unless prescribed. While Propygenta NF is effective for short-term relief of inflamed and infected skin conditions, it may cause side effects in some patients, especially when misused or used for prolonged durations. Before using Propygenta NF Cream, it is essential to understand and observe several precautions to ensure safe and effective use. 2. Avoid Use on Broken or Ulcerated Skin: Applying the drug to open wounds, cuts, or severely damaged skin may lead to excessive absorption of the steroid or antibiotic, increasing the risk of systemic side effects like adrenal suppression or kidney issues.
